earlierRuns: A full run on 916d0ed, the slice commit before the schema commit, had two Playwright failures: tests/baseline.spec.js, because docs/baseline/schemas/trace.schema.json did not describe the new checkpoint profile (fixed in c552ab3), and tests/game.spec.js TC-32-BAD-AIR-TRIGGER-UNCHANGED, a boundary case that fails when the diver drifts off x = 103 during its frames. TC-32 then failed 1 of 3 and passed 5 of 5 alone on the branch, and passed 8 of 8 on main (44f2cda); the branch's only legacy change is captureBaselineCheckpoint(), which that case does not run. Tracked in #203.

A full run on c552ab3 passed (342 unit, 72 parity, 142 e2e). The pre-review of #204, pass 1, then found that a frame's cost grew with the profile (freezeDiveState re-froze it about ten times a frame), that forecast requests cloned it into the worker, and that the autosave ran every 0.17 real s under fast-forward; and that the old fixture size was misstated (0.49 MB, not 0.55). b66ae83 fixes all three; the run above is on that commit.

A full run on b66ae83 passed (344 unit, 72 parity, 142 e2e). Codex round 1 then found that freezeDiveState reused any frozen array, whose elements might still be mutable, and that the save accepted submerged time with no depth-time sum. 4fc8e99 tracks the lists freezeDiveState builds in a WeakSet and adds the 0.5 m lower bound; the run above is on that commit.
